title: UXD launches on Solana mainnet
description: UXD Protocol opened the Mainnet Beta stablecoin on Solana with SOL-based minting for users outside restricted regions.
notes: Day-level boundary follows the official launch announcement.

title: UXD introduces its Asset Liability Management transition
description: UXD Protocol proposed expanding beyond the initial delta-neutral position into a diversified Asset Liability Management framework.
notes: The date records the official transition proposal; exact implementation milestones remain unresolved.

title: Money on Chain opens public access to DOC
description: Money on Chain presented the Rootstock protocol publicly and opened access to mint and redeem the bitcoin-collateralized DOC stablecoin.
notes: The protocol had been deployed earlier in October 2019; 12 December is used as the public launch boundary.

title: DOC expands to Arbitrum through Stargate
description: Money on Chain announced an official DOC bridge route from Rootstock to Arbitrum using LayerZero and Stargate.
notes: The Arbitrum token is a bridged representation of the continuing Rootstock-issued DOC identity.

title: Money on Chain pauses DOC minting and redemption after oracle flaw
description: Money on Chain activated its Panic Button after validating a critical OMoC oracle reliability flaw, pausing protocol minting and redemption while transfers and secondary trading continued.
notes: The official incident report states that the flaw was not exploited and no funds were lost.

title: Money on Chain implements oracle fix and restores protocol operation
description: MOC governance approved and implemented the oracle reliability fix, enabling the protocol to be safely unpaused.
notes: The governance record reports 100 percent of participating votes in favor and successful implementation.
